==Features and Overview==
==={{OoT|-}}===
{{Main|Fire Temple (Ocarina of Time)}}
The Fire Temple is the fifth [[Dungeon]] located deep within the [[Death Mountain Crater]]. Its main [[Item]] is the [[Megaton Hammer]] and its [[Boss]] is [[Volvagia]].

==={{ST|-}}===
{{Main|Fire Temple (Spirit Tracks)}}
The Fire Temple in {{ST}} is the fifth [[Dungeon]] located at the summit of the mountain in the [[Fire Realm]]. Its main [[Item]] is the [[Bow]] and its [[Boss]] is [[Cragma]].

==={{TFH|-}}===
{{Main|Fire Temple (Tri Force Heroes)}}
In {{TFH}}, the Fire Temple is the fourth and final [[Level]] of the [[Volcano]] [[Area]]. It is preceded by [[Den of Flames]] and its [[Boss]] is [[Moldorm]].

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Main|Fire Temple (Tears of the Kingdom)}}
[[File:TotK Fire Temple 2.png|thumb|right|320px|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}The entrance to the Fire Temple]]
The Fire Temple is located in the [[Eldin Canyon Depths]]. It is part of the ruins of [[Gorondia]], the ancient home of the [[Goron]]s.<ref name="TotK Game Screen"/> Its [[Boss]] is [[Marbled Gohma]].
